title: Shibayan Records - Tiny Little Adiantum (deadman 死人 Remix) [Omae Wa Mou]
description: Trap remix of ShibayanRecords' "Tiny Little Adiantum" (vocals by 3L), made by the American producer Noah Ryan Murphy under the name deadman 死人. Murphy found the original bossa nova track in an Instagram meme in 2017, could not understand the lyrics, sampled it and added hi-hat-heavy drum programming; he published "Omae Wa Mou" on 2017-09-22 as a "Lil Boom x anime" type beat. The rapper Lil Boom later bought the beat for 25 dollars and turned it into his song "Already Dead", which is why the instrumental is also known as the "Already Dead Instrumental". The remix became a viral hit two years later: it was used in TikTok dance videos and in the Minecraft "Wholesome Parrots Dancing" meme, reached number one on Spotify's Viral 50 in August 2019 and was briefly taken down after a copyright claim before returning to streaming. It samples the ShibayanRecords song of the entry 2019/tiny_little_adiantum, which is dated by its YouTube upload; the song itself was first released on the album TOHO BOSSA NOVA 2 on 2017-05-05.
